description: Codex: Space Marines (11e) DUTY IN DEATH (Assault Brethren, 1 CP) — WP-M3b (SMCodexB.gd, through the custom:sm11e dispatcher). Fixture sm11e_m3b_reactive (P1 Orks ACTIVE vs P2 Space Marines, round 2; layout in tests/helpers/gen_sm11e_m3b_fixtures.gd). Setup privileges plus the assault doctrine active for the Space Marines army. The Ork player clicks the Boyz in the fight list and assigns every attack at the Terminator Squad (real clicks); enemy_targets_unit_fight opens; a real click on 'Use on Terminator Squad' spends 1 CP; the engine's Fight On Death (05.04.05) mode is written: a Terminator destroyed before its unit has fought rolls a D6, 4+ with +1 for the assault doctrine, and stays until its unit has fought / the end of the phase. After the Boyz' attacks resolve, every destroyed Terminator was rolled for (Game Log 'DUTY IN DEATH: …').
